function.description: What you learned about your work: `self_context_manage`. YOUR OWN durable notes: lessons learned, conventions you follow, what worked and what did not. action='read' returns the current text; action='update' replaces it (≤20000 chars — consolidate, don't sprawl); action='patch' edits by exact-string replace; Every update/patch is a draft the owner reviews (/pending) and needs reason= (one sentence for the owner: why this change); when the owner turned self.autonomous_writes on, a write of your own scheduled run that quotes the soul line it serves (soul_line=) is in effect at once. This is NOT your core identity/boundaries (those are operator-owned). Pass source= (where it came from: 'measured', 'owner said', 'room_read') and observed_at=YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today) so each new or changed line is written with its provenance; that stamp counts toward the char cap.
function.name: self_context_manage
